status: declared before any evaluation; plan_20261124 B1 (owner approved); sealed U18 unopened
method: scripts/ppe.py: scrambled-Sobol perturbed-parameter ensemble over 16 knobs around r51 (wave 1, 96 points + the r51 base point), Gaussian-process emulators of every development region's temperature MAE and rain loss (log), the v4 objective computed from the emulated regions, then waves of 16 emulator-chosen points (best feasible, spread >= 0.12 apart in the unit cube) until the best evaluated point stops improving for two waves or 4 waves are spent.
base_note: r52 + e52c at 0.3 (S61 0.9978 in the screen); the base point reproduces that screen
objective: S61 + 10 x (excess of S49 over 1.0 + excess of T and P over +1 %), all vs r52 at pad 1,100 km (the atlas configuration); evaluated runs for the finalist
gates: policy v5: dev5 (90 % bootstrap upper bound < 1), T and P <= +1 %, S49 <= 1, fine28 <= 1.01, ONE paired run on sealed U18 (S <= 1 and 90 % lower bound < 1). Also reported, not gating: per-regime scores (regimes_v1; owner-approved A2) and the 12-region pad-2,200 robustness set (A1). Pass -> r53, no atlas rebuild unless the owner asks.
cost: ~2 min per evaluation: wave 1 ~2.2 h, each later wave ~35 min
note: Structural round B1: e52c stable winter cooling behind an upwind crest (prairies, Midwest, Manchuria, north China), which cut the pad-2,200 error 4.5-7.7 % alone; rebalanced with the winter-transport knobs (e52 base rate, eddy rate and scale, e108 heat barrier) and the land offset / lapse rate. e52c and e108 reach off inside the box. Close early if the predicted gain is within noise (sd ~0.005).
